title: Browse Explore
description: Public discovery of hubs and creators: search, categories, filters, Hubs vs Creators tabs, listing rules, and guest vs adult browsing.
content:
Explore is Aura Library’s public catalog—search and filter hubs and creators worldwide. It is discovery, not a social feed.

Primary action: Open Explore

How discovery works

  1. Search — Type what you need. Results sort by relevance when you search, or by popular when you browse.
  2. Filter — Narrow by category, free or paid, price range, tags, and adult visibility. Skip what you do not want.
  3. Open — Open a card to land in the hub or the creator’s profile.

Filters you can use

  • Text search
  • 16 categories
  • Free vs monetized
  • Price range
  • Custom tags
  • Adult modes
  • Sort: popular / relevance

Hubs and Creators tabs

  • Hubs (?tab=hubs) — Browse public hubs listed on Explore: curated digital artifacts ready to open.
  • Creators (?tab=creators) — Browse people who contribute. Open a profile to see their listed hubs and presence.

What gets listed

  • A hub appears on Explore when it is public, active, and listed, with the basics ready: title, cover, description, category, profile pic, adult yes/no, and public access.
  • Not every shareable hub is Explore-listed. Unlisted public hubs stay link-only and stay out of SEO indexing.
  • Listing helps people find you. It is not a ranking promise or guaranteed traffic.

Step-by-step for creators: List a hub on Explore.

Guests and adult content

  • Guests can browse most public, non-adult listings on Explore.
  • Adult hubs can be listed, but they stay hidden by default. You need the adult filter, login, and age verification to see them.
